prompt: Of the top five all-time scoring leaders of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA), which players were still playing professionally as of the 2024 season?
answer:
As of the **2024 season**, only **two players** among the NBA’s and WNBA’s top five all-time career scorers were still playing professionally:

- **LeBron James** — NBA; ranked first all-time in NBA regular-season scoring.
- **Diana Taurasi** — WNBA; ranked first all-time in WNBA regular-season scoring.

The other top-five scorers in each league had retired by 2024.
